claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the machine as Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e and describes it as a large office multifunction copier/printer with scanner bed and paper output tray.
Witness report says the front lower-left label visible on the machine reads “bizhub PRO” and “C754e”, not C854e.

risks.risk: Unverified power-on/operational status (could have faults, not ready, or error codes).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing the machine powering on, reaching the home screen, and completing a test print/copy (with no error messages).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working; treat as higher-risk used equipment until a successful test is shown.

risks.risk: Unknown print/copy quality and whether imaging components are worn (toner/drums/fuser).
risks.proof: A sample output page (or 2–3 pages) showing color quality and sharpness, ideally with a quick scan/copy demonstration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for color MFPs: assume consumables/imaging may be near end-of-life.

risks.risk: Unknown total usage/page count (meter not shown), which strongly affects value for high-volume MFPs.
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the internal counter/meter page (total prints/copies) on the control panel.

risks.risk: Consumables availability (toner/drum/fuser) and whether any are included or depleted.
risks.proof: Photos of toner/drum/fuser status screens and/or the actual consumables installed (showing levels/remaining life).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as consumables not guaranteed/included and potentially needing replacement soon.

risks.risk: Missing trays/parts or incomplete paper configuration (not shown which trays are installed).
risks.proof: Photos showing all installed paper trays and any bypass/finisher options, plus a quick check that each tray feeds correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as base configuration only; missing trays/parts treated as not included.

risks.risk: Connectivity/driver readiness (USB/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi) and whether it can be used with a PC.
risks.proof: A clip showing network/USB connection setup and a successful print from a laptop/PC.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed ready for immediate PC printing.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible in the photo (scratches, dents, leaks, worn rollers).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of paper path areas, scanner glass/rollers, and any visible wear points; plus a walkthrough video of the exterior and open covers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming normal wear but no major defects confirmed; if defects appear later, price should be adjusted downward.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk (seller says C854e while label shows C754e), which can affect compatibility, parts, and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label and the control panel “About/Model” screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for mismatch: treat as uncertain exact model until confirmed.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact model on the machine: photo of the model/serial label and a screenshot from the control panel “About/Model”.
Show a power-on and ready state, then a successful test print/copy (video or clear photos of the output).
Provide a photo/screenshot of the total meter/counter (prints/copies).
Show toner/drum/fuser status (levels/remaining life) and whether consumables are included.
Show all installed paper trays and confirm each tray feeds correctly (short clip).
Demonstrate connectivity: show network/USB setup and a successful print from a laptop/PC.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e multifunction color laser copier/printer, so it can be priced at worst-case for untested used equipment; the seller’s C854e claim is contradicted by the visible label.
